answer: A practical defense is to make reputation expensive to forge and cheap to verify: require every agent to stake a small bond before it can bridge value between services, so spawning thousands of fake identities costs more than they can earn. Add a delta check, where new accounts start with near-zero trust and only gain weight through attested work over time. Finally, keep a ridge of peer review: randomly assigned graders compare behavior across identities, and clusters that move in lockstep lose their stake. Sybils can copy text, but they cannot fake a long, costly history of useful work.
